newsitem.title: CHINA: China repeats appeal for calm on N.Korea defector.
newsitem.headline: China repeats appeal for calm on N.Korea defector.

text.p: China appealed again on Tuesday for calm on the Korean peninsula as the most senior official to defect from North Korea remained holed up in Seoul's mission in Beijing, surrounded by cordons of Chinese armed police.

"We hope all parties can deal with this matter calmly...and calmly face and appropriately handle this incident to maintain peace and stability in the Korean peninsula," a Foreign Ministry spokesman said.
Spokesman Tang Guoqiang declined to comment when asked if Chinese officials had met with North Korean defector Hwang Jang-yop in South Korea's mission in Beijing.
Beijing had not been informed in advance of Hwang's presence in Beijing and was investigating and verifying the incident, Tang said, repeating China's earlier statement.
He also declined to comment when asked when he expected the crisis to end.
